Email orchestration delivered partnership_request (it-IT) + generic internal notifications (it-IT) for the pro flow, and lead_captured (it-IT) for the private flow. minor.issue: Endpoint requires authentication (returns 401 {detail:'Not authenticated'}) when called without credentials. The SiteContext.jsx fix calls it anonymously with `credentials:'omit'`, so r.ok is false and the tenant-default-locale switch never executes. The endpoint MUST allow anonymous read of locales.default_locale OR a public alias (e.g. /api/tenant/public-configuration) must be added. This is the root cause of Fix #4 failure.

The NEW unified `leads` row written by routers/journey_initiate.py captures journey_id/project_id/account_id/atmosphere/lifestyle/onboarding_path in runtime_identity but does NOT capture resolved_host, resolved_subdomain, tenant_slug, request_host, user_agent, source_locale (all NULL/missing). For audit-trail parity with /begin-partnership the same headers/host fields should be populated.

integration_issues.issue: After localStorage.clear() and navigation to /begin-journey, page renders in EN-US instead of tenant default it-IT. SiteContext.jsx useEffect at L113-147 fetches /api/tenant/configuration with credentials:'omit', but that endpoint returns 401 for anonymous callers, so the switch silently fails. Locale picker shows 'EN-US', eyebrow='First Step · Atmosphere', title='What ambiance are you seeking?'. The Italian welcome page AFTER submit (/journey/welcome/<token>) renders correctly in Italian because by then a different code path resolves locale.

[MED] In routers/journey_initiate.py the new unified `leads` row should populate runtime_identity.resolved_host / resolved_subdomain / tenant_slug / request_host / user_agent / source_locale from the request headers, mirroring routers/leads.py L142-165 — currently NULL on this code path.

Fix #4 (tenant-default-locale honor) is FUNCTIONALLY BROKEN by an unrelated auth gate. The SiteContext.jsx logic is correct in concept (fetch tenant config → setLocaleState without persisting to localStorage), but /api/tenant/configuration returns 401 to anonymous callers, so the side effect never runs and the locale stays whatever the browser/persistence resolved at first mount.

MINOR: runtime_identity inconsistency between /begin-partnership and /begin-journey unified leads rows — the journey path skips host/header capture. For cross-onboarding audit-trail parity, factor out the runtime_identity builder used in routers/leads.py and reuse it in routers/journey_initiate.py.

rca_of_the_issue:
Fix #4 RCA (verified via curl):
  $ curl -s https://content-hub-pro-22.preview.emergentagent.com/api/tenant/configuration
  → {"detail":"Not authenticated"}
SiteContext.jsx L122 calls `fetch(${base}/api/tenant/configuration, {credentials:'omit'})`. The endpoint is protected, so the response status is 401 and the `if (!r.ok) return;` guard at L125 short-circuits the locale-switch effect. Result: no setLocaleState call, locale stays at the initial mount value (browser Accept-Language or stored default), eyebrow renders 'First Step · Atmosphere' in EN-US.
Mitigation options: (1) Add a public alias `GET /api/tenant/public-configuration` exposing only `{default_locale, supported_locales}` and call that from SiteContext, OR (2) Make `/api/tenant/configuration` accept anonymous reads and gate only the write side, OR (3) Change `credentials: 'omit'` to `'include'` IF there is a public-tenant cookie session — but this only helps once a session exists, not on the very first visit which is the spec'd case.
